messages:
Zara Khan: FYI  Northbridge quarterly readout set for Fri 9am PT. Need 4 slides: health headline, onboarding sprint status, renewal risk + mitigation options, and a 5-min demo ask. Who volunteers?
Ben Wright: Ill do onboarding sprint status. Will surface run-rate, blocked customers, and ETA for SDK patch.
Lena Ortiz: Ill draft the renewal risk slide  short bullets with risk level and recommended actions (eng + commercial).
Marco Silva: Ill own the demo ask and the 2-step fallback flow. Can someone share the most recent integration error logs?
Zara Khan: Attaching doc link: https://redwood-internal.docs/qbr/northbridge. Marco, see appendix -> integration-logs.
Ben Wright: Quick query Im running to get blocked count:
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM integration_errors WHERE created_at > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 3;
Lena Ortiz: Execs like one-line TL;DR on slide 1. Ill craft a headline: "Stable adoption; two at-risk accounts with privacy asks." Keep mitigations to two options max.
Marco Silva: Suggest mitigation A: dedicated onboarding sprint (3 eng days + 8 support hrs) and mitigation B: temporary config rollback. Ill add estimated time-to-resolution.
Zara Khan: Owners recap: Ben = onboarding numbers + SDK ETA; Lena = risk headline + commercial ask; Marco = demo + mitigations. Ill assemble slides and run a 20-min dry run Thu 3:30pm PT.
reminder-bot: Reminder created: "Northbridge readout slide freeze" Thu 6:00pm PT.
Ben Wright: One more  Northbridge requested a customer quote in the deck. Ill pull the latest CSAT comment and include it as a 1-line callout.
Zara Khan: Great. Please keep deck <= 5 slides. See you at dry run :thumbsup:
